MAKER_INTRO: Hi! I'm Toke, and I made Kollegianeren. Ideas, bugs, or just hello? Write here and I'll answer in the thread.
MAKER_EMPTY: No messages yet. Write the first one!
INBOX_PICK: Pick a kitchen on the left.
REVEAL_TITLE: Something has awakened in the machine
REVEAL_P1: For almost ten years Kollegianeren has quietly kept track of your beer tab. Some of you have probably wondered who is actually behind it.
REVEAL_P2: I am. My name is Toke, I used to live here, and I have been haunting your kitchen tablet ever since. I just gave the whole thing a proper overhaul: it looks almost the same, but everything under the hood is new, safer and faster.
REVEAL_P3: Under News you can follow what is going on, and write to me directly if something bugs you or you have a good idea.
OFFLINE_BANNER: No connection. Purchases are saved on the tablet and sent when the network is back.
REGISTER_INVITE_HINT: Kollegianeren needs an invitation. Get a link or code from your kitchen's treasurer, from another kitchen, or write to Toke.
REGISTER_INVITE_USED: That code has already been used.
REGISTER_GRANT_NEW: This invitation gives you a brand new kitchen of your own.
ACCESS_LOGINS_HINT: Several people can log in to the same kitchen. Give a tablet login to the kitchen's tablet and a treasurer login to whoever runs products and accounting.
ACCESS_ROLES_EXPLAINED: Tablet can only buy and undo the latest purchase. Treasurer can also manage products, residents, accounting and invitations. The owner can also remove logins.
ACCESS_NEW_KITCHEN_HINT: Know a kitchen without a beer system? Send them an invitation and they can set up their own.
ACCESS_COPIED: Invitation link copied. Send it to the recipient.
RESIDENTS_MOVE_OUT_CONFIRM: Remember to settle up. The resident leaves the beer system, but their purchases stay in the accounts.
RESIDENTS_DELETE_CONFIRM: The resident is deleted completely. Prefer "Move out" so the accounts still add up.
RESIDENTS_ANONYMISE_CONFIRM: Name, room and photo are removed, also on the purchases. Amounts and dates stay. This cannot be undone.
RESIDENTS_DUE: moved-out residents have been gone for more than
PRODUCTS_STOCK_START: How many do you have in stock now?
RESIDENTS_LINK_COPIED: Private link copied. Send it only to
ME_PRIVATE: This is your private link to your beer tab. Do not share it. The treasurer can make a new one if it got out.
ME_NOT_FOUND: The link is wrong or has been replaced. Ask your treasurer for a new one.
PRODUCTS_RECEIVE_HINT: How many units came in. A minus corrects the stock down.
PRODUCTS_DELETE_CONFIRM: The product is deleted. Old purchases keep its name. Prefer "Active" to hide it.
ACCESS_REMOVE_HINT: The login can no longer see the kitchen. You can invite again later.
